create_simple_relative_positional_bias: create a SimpleRelativePositionalBias module with a given max_positions parameter for transformer attention bias
create_rotary_relative_positional_bias: create a RotaryRelativePositionalBias module with embed_dim and max_positions for rotary-encoded attention bias
generate_sinusoid_embeddings: generate sine and cosine sinusoid embeddings for a given max_positions and embedding_dim
apply_rotary_embedding: apply rotary position encoding to input tensor using sine and cosine embeddings
reset_positional_bias_parameters: reset the learnable alpha and beta parameters of RotaryRelativePositionalBias with normal initialization
